description: P-Video 2: the quality-focused successor to P-Video. 5-second videos from text or a starting image, at 720p or 1080p. Compared with other video tools: budget, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.204 per 5-second video, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 720p $0.204, 1080p $0.406 (default 720p). One call = one 5-second video.
